class DisjointUnionSets {
public:
    vector<int> rank, parent;
    int n;
    
    DisjointUnionSets(int n) : n(n) {
        rank.resize(n, 1);
        parent.resize(n, -1);
    }
    
    int find(int curr) {
        if (parent[curr] == -1)
            return curr;
        return parent[curr] = find(parent[curr]);
    }
    
    void unionSets(int a, int b) {
        int s1 = find(a);
        int s2 = find(b);
        
        if (s1 != s2) {
            if (rank[s1] < rank[s2]) {
                parent[s1] = s2;
                rank[s2] += rank[s1];
            } else {
                parent[s2] = s1;
                rank[s1] += rank[s2];
            }
        }
    }
};

    long long res = 1;
    while (y > 0) {
        if (y & 1) {
            x %= MOD;
            res %= MOD;
            res = (res * x) % MOD;
        }
        y = y >> 1;
        x %= MOD;
        x = (x * x) % MOD;
    }
    return res % MOD;
}

class segmentTree {
public:
    vector<long long> arr;
    vector<long long> tree;
    
    segmentTree(vector<long long>& inputArr) {
        int n = inputArr.size();
        arr = inputArr;
        tree.resize(4 * n + 1, 0);
    }
    
    void buildTree(int s, int e, int index) {
        if (s == e) {
            tree[index] = arr[s];
            return;
        }
        
        int mid = (s + e) / 2;
        buildTree(s, mid, 2 * index);
        buildTree(mid + 1, e, 2 * index + 1);
        
        tree[index] = min(tree[2 * index], tree[2 * index + 1]);
    }
    
    long long query(int s, int e, int qs, int qe, int index) {
        if (s >= qs && e <= qe) {
            return tree[index];
        }
        
        if (qe < s || qs > e) {
            return LLONG_MAX;
        }
        
        int mid = (s + e) / 2;
        long long left = query(s, mid, qs, qe, 2 * index);
        long long right = query(mid + 1, e, qs, qe, 2 * index + 1);
        
        return min(left, right);
    }
    
    void updateNode(int s, int e, int i, long long increment, int index) {
        if (i < s || i > e) {
            return;
        }
        
        if (s == e) {
            tree[index] += increment;
            return;
        }
        
        int mid = (s + e) / 2;
        updateNode(s, mid, i, increment, 2 * index);
        updateNode(mid + 1, e, i, increment, 2 * index + 1);
        
        tree[index] = min(tree[2 * index], tree[2 * index + 1]);
    }
    
    void updateRange(int s, int e, int l, int r, long long increment, int index) {
        if (l > e || r < s) {
            return;
        }
        
        if (s == e) {
            tree[index] += increment;
        }
        
        int mid = (s + e) / 2;
        updateRange(s, mid, l, r, increment, 2 * index);
        updateRange(mid + 1, e, l, r, increment, 2 * index + 1);
        
        tree[index] = min(tree[2 * index], tree[2 * index + 1]);
    }
};

void primeSieve(int n) {
    bitset<100001> bitset;
    bitset.reset();
    
    for (long long i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (i == 0 || i == 1) {
            bitset.set(i);
            continue;
        }
        if (bitset.test(i)) continue;
        primeNumbers.push_back((int)i);
        for (long long j = i; j <= n; j += i) {
            bitset.set(j);
        }
    }
}

int countDivisors(long long number) {
    if (number == 1) return 1;
    vector<int> primeFactors;
    int index = 0;
    long long curr = primeNumbers[index];
    
    while (curr * curr <= number) {
        while (number % curr == 0) {
            number = number / curr;
            primeFactors.push_back((int)curr);
        }
        index++;
        if (index >= primeNumbers.size()) break;
        curr = primeNumbers[index];
    }
    
    if (number != 1) {
        primeFactors.push_back((int)number);
    }
    
    if (primeFactors.empty()) return 1;
    
    int current = primeFactors[0];
    int totalDivisors = 1;
    int currentCount = 1;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < primeFactors.size(); i++) {
        if (primeFactors[i] == current) {
            currentCount++;
        } else {
            totalDivisors *= currentCount;
            currentCount = 1;
            current = primeFactors[i];
        }
    }
    totalDivisors *= currentCount;
    return totalDivisors;
}

int primeExponentsCount(int n) {
    if (n <= 1) return 0;
    int sqrtN = (int)sqrt(n);
    int remainingNumber = n;
    int result = 0;
    
    for (int i = 2; i <= sqrtN; i++) {
        while (remainingNumber % i == 0) {
            result++;
            remainingNumber /= i;
        }
    }
    
    if (remainingNumber > 1) {
        result++;
    }
    return result;
}

bool next_permutation_vec(vector<int>& p) {
    for (int a = p.size() - 2; a >= 0; --a)
        if (p[a] < p[a + 1])
            for (int b = p.size() - 1;; --b)
                if (p[b] > p[a]) {
                    int t = p[a];
                    p[a] = p[b];
                    p[b] = t;
                    for (++a, b = p.size() - 1; a < b; ++a, --b) {
                        t = p[a];
                        p[a] = p[b];
                        p[b] = t;
                    }
                    return true;
                }
    return false;
}

long long getNcR(int n, int r) {
    long long p = 1, k = 1;
    if (n - r < r) r = n - r;
    
    if (r != 0) {
        while (r > 0) {
            p *= n;
            k *= r;
            long long m = __gcd(p, k);
            p /= m;
            k /= m;
            n--;
            r--;
        }
    } else {
        p = 1;

    return p;
}

void reverse_vector(vector<int>& arr) {
    int left = 0;

    while (left <= right) {
        swap_int(arr, left, right);
        left++;
        right--;
    }
}

long long expo(long long a, long long b, long long mod) {

        if ((b & 1) == 1) res = (res * a) % mod;
        a = (a * a) % mod;
        b = b >> 1;
    }
    return res;
}

long long nCr_mod(long long N, long long K, long long mod) {
    long long upper = 1;
    long long lower = 1;
    long long lowerr = 1;
    
    for (long long i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
        upper = mod_mul(upper, i, mod);
    }
    
    for (long long i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
        lower = mod_mul(lower, i, mod);
    }
    
    for (long long i = 1; i <= (N - K); i++) {
        lowerr = mod_mul(lowerr, i, mod);
    }
    
    long long answer = mod_mul(lower, lowerr, mod);
    answer = mod_div(upper, answer, mod);
    
    return answer;
}
